- 82 examples include the creator's prompts.

- Includes guidance on recreating examples.

[Browse Motif's showcase](https://createmotion.io/explore/claude-opus-5-5/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Official Anthropic resources

For baseline capabilities and prompting guidance\:

- [Introducing Claude Opus 5.5](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-opus-5-5?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Claude release notes](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes?version=published&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If your goal is to learn what these models can actually accomplish, I'd prioritize\:

| What you want to learn | Best resource |
|--------|--------|
| Copy impressive prompts | Awesome Opus 5.5 |
| See actual creative outputs | Motif |
| Compare Opus vs Sonnet | Looops |
| Build interactive websites and games | Awesome Use Cases |
| Generate cinematic animations | Video Prompts GitHub |


**One important distinction\:** These are community-curated examples, not independently verified benchmark results. Check the original creator posts when exact prompt provenance matters.

I'd particularly recommend exploring the same-prompt Opus/Sonnet comparisons. They're much more informative than looking at impressive Opus outputs in isolation.
